summary:
ATMOS lane is finished (attempt 3 picked up the cut-off attempt 2). The clouds no longer disappear: their drift wrapped nowhere, so after 10-30 minutes idle they had all left the sky. They now move the way the reference videos show (leftward, about 7 px/s) on a seamless 404.76 s loop. The jump back to the start always happens off screen, at every camera, pointer and hold view. Measured over 24 frames (idle up to 30 minutes, 4 pointer positions), cloud cover stays at 0.74-1.10 of F000's, so the sky is never empty. The invented sway, breath and boil on the cloud cards are gone, and the cards now have F000's soft edges.

Attempt 3 found that the cloud positions in the artist's .blend are not the video's (every cloud animation was deleted from the file). I fitted each of the 6 cards to F000 relative to the mountains, and the layout matches F000 when the intro ends (t 3.4 s). Sky error drops 6.00 to 5.27, and the summit box goes from +30.5 to +5.0 levels.

With the left card in its F000 place, its lower-right lobe sits exactly where F000's "summit puff" is, and it drifts off within about 4 s as in both videos. The artist's file has no wisp volume; the summit wisp card was added by the team in an earlier round to fake that puff. It doubled the puff and showed one in the hold, where F420 has none. It is now off by default; ?atmoswisp=0 restores the old card and ?atmoswisp=gust the attempt-1 gusts.

Also in this lane, from attempts 1-2: a world-anchored ground-mist bank that rolls over the left mountain bases on the reference's timing; replacement of a haze field that made whole regions brighten and darken over minutes with a small wisp drift; and the iceberg and dark-ridge grades re-fitted to F000.

Checks, all on the final build:
- ?atmos=r10 matches MAIN within max 1 level, 0 px > 2, with the hero area masked because MAIN now includes the RINGS merge.
- No page or console errors in shoot_qc (all poses), shoot_pointer, shoot_sweep, or at T0, T2, projected, mirror and phone.
- Frame-to-frame change is at the dither floor (no flicker).
- Paired frame cost vs MAIN: -4 to +2 % at rest and in the hold, +2 to +6 % with the mist fully in. The contended perf_probe run read 0.91x rest fps; that method is too noisy here to decide.
- Typecheck 0/0.
- The lab on :5176 is stopped; :5173 and :3000 were left running.

The ±3-level region target is not met everywhere (sky_mid -5.8, corner TL +4.4, far-right range +12, baked base haze +6 to +18, summit tone +5). Causes and owners are in HANDOFF section 6. On the user's question "progressnya belum bisa dilihat?": this lane is not merged into MAIN yet, so :5173 does not show it. To preview, serve LANE/retrux-web on a free port with hero-lab/serve.mjs.

open_issues: Rest region means are not all within +-3 of F000 (sky_mid -5.8, corner TL +4.4); the remaining sky deviation (~+-4) comes from three's polynomial AgX vs Blender's LUT and the v7 plate's flatter sky. A LUT-exact AgX needs a full re-tune by the grade owner.

Far-right range +12 levels: the low right cloud card (CLOUDS[4], 140 m) veils a range that is painted on the BG001 sky card (raycast hit at 359 m), so no card depth can sit behind it. ENV bake fix: real geometry or an occluder mask.
Clear-state base haze is baked into the env textures (ridge foot +18 R, foothills +8, shore +6 vs F000). ENV fix: re-bake without V2_BaseMist so the engine's mist bank carries all of the base mist.

The rest camera sits about (-8, -2) px off F000 (massif summit, iceberg and far range all at -8 px; about 0.27 deg yaw). The camera owner should fix it; the clouds are registered relative to the mountains, so they stay right if it changes.
The massif summit's own tone reads whiter and less blue-grey than F000 (env bake), even with the puff now correct.
The default plate lake shows the clouds' Cycles reflections frozen at the .blend positions. The WATER lane's planar mirror reflects the live cards (they carry uCloudShift x and y).

QC protocol: shoot_qc captures q00 at about 9 s and q03 at about 16 s, when the mist is rolling in and the clouds have drifted about 40 px. Compare against F000 at t = 3.4 + k x 404.762 s with the bank and puff pinned (HANDOFF section 3).

The ENV lane's gate 'one summit wisp in every view' assumed the team's wisp card was part of the reference; this lane turned it off by default with evidence (HANDOFF 1.3). The lead should confirm when merging.
Debug API: __hero.debug.pointer(NaN) leaves the camera NaN (black frames) for the rest of the session. Visitors can't trigger it, but it is worth a guard.
Merge: the HeroEngine.ts hunk is next to the RINGS merge lines now in MAIN (3-way merge keeps both). PlateEnvironment.ts is shared with the WATER lane: the band chunk must keep calling plateMistWisp.
